prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 44 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1463; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient was seen after a sideswipe collision during a lane change and reports neck and back strain. The force and mechanism of the impact are consistent with the injuries described. Care has included 44 visits, with sessions occurring nearly every day, and new body areas were added several weeks after the collision. Most clinical findings rest on the patient's own description of pain. Imaging and physical examination tests have all been within normal limits. The history contains no known prior injury to the same areas. Billing records show no repeated charges for the same services. Future management will focus on symptom control, a gradual return to normal activity, and a review of the treatment plan given the frequency of visits and the spread of complaints.
